summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching eight Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 17-22, 2026, disclosing on-market share repurchases for cancellation. The September 16, 2026 tranche covered 106,652 ordinary shares (0.0088% of issued shares) at USD 2.2097 per share. Issued shares remained 1,214,041,449 after the buyback. No board recommendation, advisor mandate, premium, or fixed aggregate program size is stated. Watch the cumulative repurchase pace and treasury-share cancellation timing for any incremental EPS and overhang effect.
